summary: Centralized reusable Svelte primitives (Menu, ScrollPanel, SelectField, Tabs) into packages/ui, added a shared styles.css entrypoint that re-exports design tokens and component CSS, wired the app to import '@gizmo/ui/styles', and pinned svelte to 5.56.10 to fix missing Tooltip.Provider context errors that broke the app test suite. Also committed a separate protocol-package decomposition that splits wire schemas by domain into cohesive modules.
decisions: Move Menu.svelte, ScrollPanel.svelte, SelectField.svelte, and Tabs.svelte from apps/app/src/lib/components into packages/ui/src to centralize reusable primitives.

Expose a new subpath export './styles' -> './src/styles.css' from @gizmo/ui and have the app import '@gizmo/ui/styles' instead of the design package's nested CSS, because Vite drops the second nested @import from @gizmo/design/index.css.
Add flattened subpath exports './component-styles' and './tokens' on @gizmo/design so packages/ui/src/styles.css can import them directly.
Pin svelte to exact version 5.56.10 across @gizmo/app, @gizmo/design, and @gizmo/ui to eliminate the 'Tooltip.Provider context not found' test failures caused by a newer svelte.
Add a side-effect import declaration for '@gizmo/ui/styles' in apps/app/src/vite-env.d.ts so svelte-check accepts the bare CSS import.

Split protocol wire schemas into cohesive per-domain modules (sessions, projects, resources, extensions, Git, providers, registry, events, responses, parsers) under packages/protocol/src with requests grouped under src/requests/, keeping src/index.ts as a 13-line compatibility barrel.
Commit the protocol refactor and the UI stylesheet refactor as two separate commits.
Kick off parallel subagents to behavior-preservingly split project-catalog.ts, WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte, and websocket-server.ts, each with a <=300 LOC per-file cap, without committing.
errors: svelte-check reported 'Cannot find name sessionTitleLimit' in packages/protocol/src/core.ts and 'Cannot find module or type declarations for side-effect import of @gizmo/ui/styles' in apps/app/src/main.ts; resolved by adding the ambient module declaration for '@gizmo/ui/styles' in apps/app/src/vite-env.d.ts (the sessionTitleLimit errors were transient and cleared on later checks).

pnpm test failed with 35 failing tests in apps/app, root cause 'Context "Tooltip.Provider" not found' from bits-ui/runed; resolved by pinning svelte to exact 5.56.10 across @gizmo/app, @gizmo/design, and @gizmo/ui, after which all 165 tests passed.
